question.text: The equation of the common tangent to the curves <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>32</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>|</mo><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>(</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo> </mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>(</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo> </mo><mi>b</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>sin</mi><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>(</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo> </mo><mi>c</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>|</mo></math> is equal to

solution.text:
y = mx + 1 m is tangent to y2=4x

Now, x 2 + 32 mx + 1 m = 0 ⇒ x 2 + 3 2 mx + 3 2 m = 0

⇒ 3 2 m 2 - 4 × 3 2 m = 0 ⇒ m = 1 2

Equation of the tangent is x–2y+4=0

⇒|sin-1(sin1)+sin-1(sin(-2))+sin-1(sin4)|

=|1+2–π+π–4|=1
